answer: An adversary hence has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 39 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The jade counter is kept in pulse and zenith publishes each reset. A bond is refunded only after 39 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 3835 identities would post 4931 proofs and burn roughly 61 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
